book.open_blocks.welcome.title: Welcome!
book.open_blocks.welcome.content:
World Domination with OpenBlocks is a guide to the mod's blocks, items, and oddities. Choose a section or turn the page with the arrows, Page Up, or Page Down.

Hover over a recipe ingredient to see its name. Home opens the cover and End opens the last spread.

book.open_blocks.config.title: Configuration
book.open_blocks.config.content: Client settings are in config/open_blocks-client.toml inside your game directory. Server settings are in serverconfig/open_blocks-server.toml inside the world directory. Change server settings on the host for multiplayer worlds.
book.open_blocks.restore_inv.title: Inventory backup
book.open_blocks.restore_inv.content:
Operators can use /ob_inventory store to back up a player's inventory. Death and grave backups also write inventory-*.dat files in the world's data directory.

Run /ob_inventory restore <player> <id> to restore a backup, or /ob_inventory spawn <id> to drop its contents. Tab completion shows the available forms and IDs.
book.open_blocks.bkey.title: The Infamous B Key
book.open_blocks.bkey.content: Eat Tasty Clay and press Be Silly to drop a brick. The default key is B. For digestion to work, set tomfoolery.weAreSeriousPeople to false in both the client and server configuration.
book.open_blocks.unstable.title: Unstable Enchantment
book.open_blocks.unstable.content: Wear Unstable boots and land from a fall of more than four blocks to bounce without taking fall damage. Hold sneak to land normally. Unstable chestplates, leggings, and helmets react to melee hits and arrows. Each blast uses gunpowder and armor durability in survival. Level III can break blocks when the server allows it.
book.open_blocks.laststand.title: Last Stand Enchantment
book.open_blocks.laststand.content: Last Stand spends experience points to leave you at half a heart when a hit would take you below it. Stronger hits cost more, and the total enchantment level on your equipped armor lowers the cost. The server can change the formula.
book.open_blocks.flimflam.title: Flim-Flam Enchantment
book.open_blocks.flimflam.content: Flim Flam reduces an opponent's luck in player combat. The enchantment levels on your sword are weighed against the opponent's armor. Enough enchanted armor can turn the trick back on the attacker. Low luck can trigger strange effects. Craft a book with one to four emeralds in separate crafting slots for the matching enchantment level.
book.open_blocks.entry.auto_anvil: Supply Liquid XP to repair, rename, or combine items. Side tabs control which faces can accept fluid and items or dispense the result.
book.open_blocks.entry.auto_enchantment_: Supply Liquid XP and put a tool or book in the table. Nearby bookshelves increase the available power. Select a level and use the side tabs to configure automation.
book.open_blocks.entry.beartrap: Use the trap to open its jaws. A mob that walks into it is held in place. Use the trap again to release it. A comparator reports whether the trap has caught something.
book.open_blocks.entry.big_button: Use the Big Button to pulse redstone. Sneak-use with an empty hand to change the pulse length. It can attach to any sturdy face.
book.open_blocks.entry.big_button_wood: Use the wooden Big Button to pulse redstone. Arrows can also press it. Sneak-use with an empty hand to change the pulse length.
book.open_blocks.entry.block_breaker: Aim the machine at the block to break and give it a redstone pulse. It uses its configured tools and sends harvested drops to a connected inventory or its own buffer.
book.open_blocks.entry.block_placer: Fill the machine with blocks and aim it at the placement position. Each redstone pulse tries to place one item in front of it.
book.open_blocks.entry.builder_guide: The Builder Guide shows the same markers as a Guide. Use a block on it to place one marker in survival. In creative, put obsidian above the guide and use the block to fill the outline.
book.open_blocks.entry.cannon: A redstone signal launches items from an adjacent inventory. Sneak-use the Pointer on the cannon and again on the destination to aim it. A Vacuum Hopper can catch falling items.
book.open_blocks.entry.canvas: The white canvas is a surface for painting. Use a loaded brush on a face. Layer prepared stencils for patterns and clean them away with a squeegee.
book.open_blocks.entry.canvas_glass: Painting glass wraps it in a transparent canvas while preserving its model. A squeegee restores the glass when all its paint and stencils are cleared.
book.open_blocks.entry.donation_station: Put an item in the sample slot to see information about its authors and donation links, when provided by its mod.
book.open_blocks.entry.drawing_table: Insert blank stencil sheets. Select a pattern to cut stencils, or open the glyph tab to print letters and symbols from text.
book.open_blocks.entry.elevator: Place two same-color elevators in a vertical line. Jump to go up and sneak to go down. Nearby blocks can obstruct the path. Craft with dye to change the color.
book.open_blocks.entry.elevator_rotating: Travel as with an ordinary elevator of the same color. Arriving on a rotating elevator turns you toward the direction it faces.
book.open_blocks.entry.fan: Airflow pushes players, mobs, and loose items. Aim the fan with its controls and scale its strength with a redstone signal.
book.open_blocks.entry.flag: Mount a flag on top of a block or on a wall. Turn upright flags to face another direction and recolor the fabric with carpet.
book.open_blocks.entry.golden_egg: Place the golden egg to hatch a Mini-Me that takes the owner's appearance and follows them. Keep room around the egg while it rises and hatches.
book.open_blocks.entry.grave: A grave can keep a player's items following death. Read it with an empty hand or use a shovel to dig up the drops. A successful dig wears the shovel and leaves the memorial in place. The server controls grave spawning and optional recovery files.
book.open_blocks.entry.guide: Choose a shape and adjust its size with the guide's face controls. Its ghost blocks show where the building materials go. The default settings use a redstone signal to show the markers.
book.open_blocks.entry.heal: The healing block restores a small amount of health and food while its conditions are met. It is intended for creative use.
book.open_blocks.entry.item_dropper: Fill the dropper and give it a redstone pulse to eject an item in the direction it faces. Its screen sets launch speed and can scale speed with signal strength.
book.open_blocks.entry.ladder: The Jaded Ladder combines a trapdoor with a ladder. Open it to climb through the hatch.
book.open_blocks.entry.paint_can: Make or refill colored paint in a Paint Mixer. Set the can down and dip a Paint Brush into it to load the brush.
book.open_blocks.entry.paint_mixer: Mix cyan, magenta, yellow, and black pigments to choose a color. Put a milk bucket or paint can in the mixer to make or refill a can.
book.open_blocks.entry.path: Scatter stones across the ground for a decorative path.
book.open_blocks.entry.projector: Insert a surveyed height map to display a rotating terrain hologram. Power the projector and use its screen to inspect the map.
book.open_blocks.entry.rope_ladder: Place the ladder against a wall to unroll rungs downward. Survival placement normally uses one item per rung.
book.open_blocks.entry.scaffolding: Stack temporary scaffolding upward to reach a build. The blocks can break as they decay. They also work as fuel.
book.open_blocks.entry.sky: Apply a redstone signal to show the current dimension's sky through the block. Combine it with a redstone torch to change its polarity.
book.open_blocks.entry.sky_inverted: Shows the dimension's sky while unpowered. A redstone signal restores the solid surface. Combine it with a redstone torch to change its polarity.
book.open_blocks.entry.sponge: Place the sponge to clear nearby water, including water inside waterlogged blocks. Lava burns the sponge.
book.open_blocks.entry.sprinkler: Supply water and place the sprinkler near crops. Add bone meal to increase its growth rate.
book.open_blocks.entry.tank: Store fluids in a tank and join adjacent tanks to share their contents. Exchange fluid with buckets or another container. Use an XP-filled tank with an empty hand to withdraw experience.
book.open_blocks.entry.target: Power the target to unfold it. Projectile hits produce a redstone signal based on how close they land to the center. Recover the arrows from the target.
book.open_blocks.entry.trophy: Mob kills can drop miniature trophies. Use a placed trophy to hear its mob. Some trophies also offer rewards or special effects after a cooldown.
book.open_blocks.entry.vacuum_hopper: Collect nearby items and experience. Use the side tabs to set separate item and fluid outputs. Redstone pauses collection.
book.open_blocks.entry.village_highlight: Power this block in a village to show its boundary and where villagers search for iron golem spawn positions. A redstone output reports vacant beds in the surveyed area.
book.open_blocks.entry.xp_bottler: Supply Liquid XP and glass bottles. The bottler spends eight XP points per Bottle o’ Enchanting. Configure input and output faces in its screen.
book.open_blocks.entry.xp_drain: Place the drain above an OpenBlocks tank. Stand on it to store your experience as Liquid XP. It also collects XP orbs.
book.open_blocks.entry.xp_shower: Attach the shower to a tank with Liquid XP and power it to release XP orbs below. A drain underneath can collect them again.
book.open_blocks.entry.cartographer: Deploy the assistant and sneak-use it with an Empty Map to survey the terrain. Retrieve the map with sneak-use or pack the assistant by attacking it.
book.open_blocks.entry.crane_backpack: Equip the backpack and use a Crane Control to deploy the magnet. It can lift mobs and allowed blocks. Release cargo over a valid placement spot.
book.open_blocks.entry.crane_control: Hold use to raise the crane magnet or sneak-use to lower it. Attack to pick up or release cargo.
book.open_blocks.entry.crayon_glasses: Wear glasses the same color as a Magic Crayon drawing to reveal it. Use a crayon when crafting the glasses to select the lens color.
book.open_blocks.entry.cursor: Sneak-use the Cursor on a block to link it. Then look into the air and use the Cursor in your main hand to interact with the linked block. Farther uses spend XP in survival. The default range is just under eight blocks.
book.open_blocks.entry.dev_null: Sneak-use /dev/null to open its slot. Store one type of item and it will pick up that type, voiding overflow. Use it on a block face to place the blocks it holds.
book.open_blocks.entry.empty_map: Give this map to a Cartographer to survey an area. Craft it by itself to step through survey scales. Combine a blank with a surveyed map of the same scale to make a copy.
book.open_blocks.entry.epic_eraser: Craft this with an item to remove its lore. Its name, damage, enchantments, and other data remain. The eraser lasts for 15 items.
book.open_blocks.entry.glyph: Print glyphs in the Drawing Table and attach them to a wall to form labels. Place multiple characters on the same block face.
book.open_blocks.entry.golden_eye: Sneak-use the eye to learn a nearby structure. Use it again to launch the eye toward its destination and pick it up after it lands. Recharge it in a crafting grid with Ender Pearls.
book.open_blocks.entry.hang_glider: Use the glider to deploy it and steer as you fall. Sneak to dive and gain speed. Thermals can provide lift in suitable weather and terrain.
book.open_blocks.entry.height_map: This map holds a Cartographer's survey of terrain and liquid heights. Place it in a Projector for a hologram. Copies of the same survey share map data.
book.open_blocks.entry.info_book: The Information Book describes OpenBlocks and shows available crafting recipes. Open it from your main hand to browse the catalogues, help pages, and original changelogs.
book.open_blocks.entry.luggage: Deploy Luggage to pick up loose items. Use it to open its inventory and sneak-use to pack it up. A lightning strike expands its capacity.
book.open_blocks.entry.magic_pencil: Place invisible shapes with a Magic Pencil. Sneak-use to change the shape. Pencil Glasses reveal the shapes.
book.open_blocks.entry.magic_crayon: Place colored shapes that viewers with matching Crayon Glasses can see and stand on. Sneak-use to switch placement modes.
book.open_blocks.entry.miracle_magnet: Equip this upgrade on a CC: Tweaked turtle. A Lua program can deploy and steer the magnet to move cargo.
book.open_blocks.entry.paintbrush: Load a brush in a paint can or craft it with dye. Use it on a face to paint that face, or sneak-use to paint all faces.
book.open_blocks.entry.pedometer: Use the pedometer to start a route or read your progress. Sneak-use to reset it. The model changes while you are moving.
book.open_blocks.entry.pencil_glasses: Wear these glasses to reveal and select shapes made with a Magic Pencil.
book.open_blocks.entry.pointer: Sneak-use the Pointer on a Cannon and then on a destination. The cannon follows the aimed trajectory when powered.
book.open_blocks.entry.serious_glasses: Wear these glasses to see, select, and stand on all imaginary drawings.
book.open_blocks.entry.sleeping_bag: Use the bag from your main hand or equip it in the chest slot to sleep on solid ground. When you wake, the bag is returned and your respawn point stays where you set it.
book.open_blocks.entry.slimalyzer: Carry the Slimalyzer to find slime chunks. It lights up and pings when it enters one. It also works as a dropped item.
book.open_blocks.entry.sonic_glasses: Wear the glasses to see sound sources. Different sounds display different icons, even behind blocks. The amount of dimming can be set in the client configuration.
book.open_blocks.entry.sponge_on_a_stick: Use the sponge on wet blocks to soak up nearby water. Cleaning water uses durability. Lava burns the tool.
book.open_blocks.entry.squeegee: Use the squeegee to clean a painted face. Sneak-use to clean the whole block. The last coat of paint or stencil reveals the original block.
book.open_blocks.entry.stencil: Use the Drawing Table to cut a stencil from a blank. Apply the stencil to a face and color it with a loaded brush. Stencils on the same face can be layered.
book.open_blocks.entry.tasty_clay: Eat Tasty Clay to store a brick when the digestion option is enabled. Use the Be Silly key to drop the brick.
book.open_blocks.entry.technicolor_glass: Wear them to see every type of imaginary drawing. Look for a pair in mineshaft and dungeon chests.
book.open_blocks.entry.unprepared_stenci: Insert a blank stencil sheet into the Drawing Table to cut a pattern or print a glyph.
book.open_blocks.entry.wrench: Use the Big Metal Bar on the face of a compatible block to rotate it. Sneak-use for single chests, levers, and buttons.
book.open_blocks.entry.xp_bucket: Collect a source block of Liquid XP when direct filling is enabled. Empty the bucket into a tank or place the fluid in the world.
